about: Intended, ruled differences from the edge-recorded golden (vote-path-golden.json), one entry per changed case. See the header of __tests__/integration/vote-path-recordings.test.ts. Emptied whenever the golden is re-recorded on edge.

entries.whole_response_reason: The recorded response was the bug (#2952): the owner, pid 0, was served their own already-voted statement (tid 3) with remaining equal to total. The response is now a different statement with different counts, so the whole response is replaced.
entries.why: Two ruled changes meet in this case. (1) #2956: GET /nextComment honours pid 0 (the first participant); it no longer offers statements that participant has already voted on, and counts remaining against their votes. With that alone nothing was left for the owner and the response was {"currentPid":0}. (2) POST /comments no longer casts an automatic pass for a seed's author, so the owner has not voted on seed tid 0 and is offered it: remaining 1 of total 6.
